root_cause: The datepicker widget steals focus when opened and traps Tab navigation inside its popup, preventing focus from moving to the next form field.
repair_strategy: After showing the datepicker, explicitly return focus to the associated input element so that subsequent Tab presses move to the next field.
expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key navigation will move focus from the visit date input to the access notes input when the datepicker is open, allowing keyboard users to continue filling the form.
functional_risks: Potentially interfering with datepicker keyboard navigation if the input loses focus while the popup is open; however the datepicker still receives keystrokes via its listener on the input element, so date picking functionality should remain unchanged.
verification_requirements: Tab from #visit-date moves focus to #notes when datepicker is open
Datepicker still responds to ArrowRight/Enter to select a date
Closing datepicker with Escape returns focus to input
